name: family-tasks
description: Скрипты для локальной разработки; у web/ и server/ свои package.json

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: npm run dev:infra && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n server,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.dev:infra: [ -f .env ] || cp .env.example .env; docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --wait db mailpit
scripts.dev:stop: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml stop db mailpit
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix web test
